name: Ascended Gods: Benchmark
detailed_description:
Ascended Gods: Benchmark Edition

Unleash the full potential of your gaming rig with Ascended Gods: Benchmark Edition, a cutting-edge performance tool built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5. Step into a breathtaking world of divine realms and celestial chaos, where your hardware will be pushed to its limits and meticulously measured across a suite of advanced benchmarks. This isn’t just a test—it’s an experience that showcases the stunning capabilities of next-gen gaming technology.

Benchmark Your Power

Dive into a detailed performance analysis with real-time metrics tailored for enthusiasts and gamers alike:

  • Average Frame Rate: See how smoothly your system handles the intense demands of Ascended Gods’ sprawling environments.

  • Minimum Frame Rate: Identify your rig’s baseline performance during the most taxing moments and dynamic effects.

  • Detailed World & Lighting: Explore a richly crafted universe featuring Unreal Engine 5’s signature Nanite geometry and Lumen global illumination. From shimmering godly citadels to shadowed abyssal plains, this very scene is a visual masterpiece designed to stress-test your GPU with intricate details and real-time lighting.

  • Latency Measurement: Fine-tune your setup with precise latency tracking between game, GPU, and CPU. This benchmark lets you measure and optimize input-to-render responsiveness, giving you the edge in understanding your system’s end-to-end performance (requires compatible hardware).

A Divine Stress Test

Ascended Gods: Benchmark Edition isn’t a synthetic tool, it’s a real-world gaming scenario wrapped in an awe-inspiring package. Traverse a dynamic world where towering deities clash amidst volumetric fog, ray-traced reflections, and cascading particle effects. Whether you’re benchmarking a high-end RTX 40-series GPU or pushing an older card to its limits, this edition reveals how your hardware stacks up against the future of gaming.

Think your rig reigns supreme? Prove it on the global stage:

  • Leaderboards: Compare your scores with players worldwide. Each benchmark mode—whether focused on raw frame rate, graphical fidelity, or latency—features its own leaderboard, showcasing the highest-performing systems and the masterminds behind them. Will you ascend to the top?

Why Ascended Gods?

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, this benchmark harnesses the latest in gaming tech like Nanite, Lumen, Virtual Shadow Maps, and more. Delivering a visually stunning and technically demanding experience. It’s not just about numbers, it’s about understanding how your system performs in a world that mirrors the next generation of AAA titles. Whether you’re a hardcore gamer, a PC builder, or a tech enthusiast, Ascended Gods: Benchmark Edition offers the tools and spectacle to test, tweak, and triumph.

System Requirements

  • Minimum: Intel 7th Gen CPU or equivalent, Nvidia GTX 1080 or equivalent GPU, 8 GB RAM

  • Recommended: Intel 12th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5000-series CPU, Nvidia GTX 1660 or higher, 8 GB RAM (Nvidia Reflex requires RTX 20-series or newer for latency features)

  • Storage: Approximately 20 GB (high-res assets included)

Ascend beyond the ordinary. Download Ascended Gods: Benchmark Edition and see where your hardware stands in the pantheon of performance.

If any issues or bugs appear on your system, please contact me with support@ascendedgods.com
